items.Sentence: The headworks consist of one lift station. The station does not have any influent screening. Manual maintenance is performed to remove large debris from the suction side of influent pumps.

Conventional treatment ponds are used. The main treatment pond (Pond 2) is 8-acres wide and 7 feet deep equipped with two floating aerators. The water from the Primary and main treatment pond then flows to Pond 1, a 0.4-acre wide and 7 feet deep pond before disposal. ... Ponds provide both primary and biological treatment.

Pond 3 is an unlined emergency overflow storage pond. Any wastewater that flows in pond 3 stays in pond 3.

Solids are accumulated in the treatment ponds and are only removed by dredging and then disposed at a nearby municipal landfill facility when needed. The ultimate destination of biosolids produced is Monterey Regional Waste Management District - Landfill Facility located at 14201 Del Monte Blvd, Marina, CA
From Pond 1, wastewater is land disposed via spray fields with a total area of approximently 15 acres.
